subscriptions.reason: Chased the next vllm-ascend release line above the 0.30.0 base: v0.32.0rc1 (prerelease whitelisted for vllm-ascend) is paired with upstream vLLM v0.32.0, CANN 9.2.1 and torch-npu 2.10.0/post7, matching the existing recipe; base images v0.32.0rc1{-a5,-a3,-310p} are built from the releases/v0.32.0rc tag push workflow; LMCache is disabled because LMCache-Ascend (v0.5.7, anchored to LMCache v0.5.6) declares support for vLLM 0.23-0.30 only.

packages.reason: v0.5.7 (LMCACHE_UPSTREAM_TAG v0.5.6) supports vLLM 0.23-0.30 on CANN only; keeping the old pair with vLLM 0.32 would mix lines, so LMCache is disabled.

packages.name: mooncake
packages.reason: Stable mooncake v0.3.14 ships mooncake-transfer-engine-npu 0.3.14 wheels (cp312 amd64/arm64) and the vllm-ascend v0.32.0rc1 line requires mooncake-transfer-engine-npu 0.3.14.rc1 or newer; 0.3.14 is the stable equivalent.

packages.name: vllm-omni
packages.reason: vLLM-Omni v0.32.0 (tag commit 5917730a) is the release aligned with vLLM 0.32.0, preferred over a main-branch commit.

patches.reason: Context in vllm/utils/network_utils.py at v0.32.0 still matches both hunks (_get_reserved_port_range/get_open_port unchanged).
Context in vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/mooncake_connector.py at v0.32.0rc1 (_get_remote_host_info_by_port) still matches.

vLLM-Omni v0.32.0 changed the sys.modules snapshot to list(...) and rebinding to setattr(); the patch.py --omni gate hunk was rewritten for the new context, and the obsolete npu runner hunks (num_scheduled_tokens_compressed_list; _prepare_inputs is a 3-tuple again in v0.32.0) were removed.
vllm_omni/quantization/factory.py at v0.32.0 still calls _register_humming_stubs() at the same location with matching context.

subscriptions.reason: Recipe already pins SGLang 0.5.23 on quay.io/ascend/sglang v0.5.23-cann9.1.0 (a3/950), the latest stable upstream line; no LMCache or appendix components are configured for SGLang on Ascend.
